The bottom panel features a real young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a plain white t-shirt. He faces the camera directly with an extremely expressive and energetic smile, establishing the interactive POV context. (2) As the music shifts, the man holds up a Häagen-Dazs ice cream bar in a green and chocolate-colored box. He moves the product toward the camera while mimicking a surprised and delighted facial expression. The top screen shows the character Ruby performing solo. The setting behind the man is a simple domestic interior with a blue wall and a gray pillow visible on a bed. (3) The man continues to cycle through various ice cream products, holding up a strawberry-flavored bar and a cookies-and-cream flavored bar in sequence. He points at the products and places his hand over his heart to synchronize with the emotional beats of the on-screen lyrics. Each phase is marked by his rapid hand movements and exaggerated, joyful reactions aimed at the viewer.
